description: This Java class, ModelDataFile, models the structure and metadata of a data file used within the OFBiz framework. It contains fields for file characteristics such as name, typeCode, sender, receiver, record length, delimiter, encoding, and associated record definitions. The class provides getter and setter methods for these properties, as well as utility methods to retrieve specific records by name.

classes.name: ModelDataFile
classes.description: Represents metadata and structure for a data file in OFBiz, including fields like name, typeCode, sender, receiver, record length, delimiter, and a list of record definitions.

methods.name: getModelRecord
methods.description: Retrieves a ModelRecord from the list of records by its name.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the data file.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the data file.

methods.name: getTypeCode
methods.description: Returns the type code of the data file.

methods.name: setTypeCode
methods.description: Sets the type code of the data file.

methods.name: getSender
methods.description: Returns the sender entity of the data file.

methods.name: setSender
methods.description: Sets the sender entity of the data file.

methods.name: getReceiver
methods.description: Returns the receiver entity of the data file.

methods.name: setReceiver
methods.description: Sets the receiver entity of the data file.

methods.name: getRecordLength
methods.description: Returns the record length in bytes, applicable for fixed-length records.

methods.name: setRecordLength
methods.description: Sets the record length in bytes.

methods.name: getDelimiter
methods.description: Returns the delimiter character used in the file.

methods.name: setDelimiter
methods.description: Sets the delimiter character used in the file.

methods.name: getStartLine
methods.description: Returns the starting line number for reading the file.

methods.name: setStartLine
methods.description: Sets the starting line number for reading the file.

methods.name: getSeparatorStyle
methods.description: Returns the separator style (fixed-length, delimited).

methods.name: setSeparatorStyle
methods.description: Sets the separator style.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the file.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the file.

methods.name: getEOLType
methods.description: Returns the end-of-line type (CRLF or CR).

methods.name: setEOLType
methods.description: Sets the end-of-line type.

methods.name: getRecords
methods.description: Returns the list of ModelRecord definitions.

methods.name: setRecords
methods.description: Sets the list of ModelRecord definitions.

methods.name: getEncodingType
methods.description: Returns the file encoding type.

methods.name: setEncodingType
methods.description: Sets the file encoding type.
